confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors come from Numbeo-based snapshots (2025 to June 2026) and undated listing sites, adjusted upward for tourist-area pricing. Restaurant meal and beer anchors are the firmest. Cocktail and wine_glass are weaker and were set from the local beer relationship (cocktail about 2x beer, wine about 2.8x beer) plus the reported Koh Samui wine markup of roughly 3x home prices. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and the Koh Samui context; no accommodation search was run and no live listings were checked. The FX observation came from an RBA-attributed summary of the exchange-rates overview page in search results; I did not open the page directly, so verify it before relying on it.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Thai resort-island pricing, using Koh Samui's reported restaurant and café averages with a tourist-area uplift. Comparable to other Southeast Asian beach and resort towns with similar Thai price levels, such as Phuket and Koh Phangan. Accommodation is a model estimate, not a sourced comparison.
